name: claude-sdlc-skills
description: AI-native SDLC skills for Claude Code and other coding agents: requirement intake & audit, AI test orchestration, adversarial review gate, in-flight decision review, release config audit, write-time guardrail enforcement.

plugins.name: claude-sdlc-skills
plugins.description: Six battle-tested SDLC skills: sdlc-intent (PRD digest + six-layer audit), sdlc-test (cases/static/exec/report with human checkpoints), sdlc-gate (fresh-context review gate with 4 adversarial subagents), sdlc-doubt (adversarial re-check of non-trivial decisions), sdlc-config-review (release config key scanner for Apollo/Nacos), sdlc-guardrails (deterministic write-time red-line engine: PostToolUse hook + pre-commit + baseline scan).
